spread_cost_tier_assignment: Fixed at the trade's entry-day (t-1) ADV tier for the life of the trade (both entry and exit legs charged at the same rate); charged on turnover (sum |weight change| that day) per symbol, not on notional held.
short_borrow_fee_accrual: Accrued daily on the held short notional (|weight| * 0.01 / 252 per session while the position is open), applies only to DRIFT_NEWS_* candidates (top-1000-ADV tier, easy-to-borrow proxy).
fill_convention: Signal at session close of day t; fill at the open of session t+1; daily returns close-to-close with next-open fills via the same P&L formula as the frozen S3 engine (scripts/run_h20260922_05_salvage.py legs()/simulate()), reused unedited for the leg-return formulas and extended (in this iteration's own script) to support a per-symbol cost-bps vector and the borrow-fee term, which the frozen engine does not support.
cash_sleeve: BIL (risk-free proxy, consistent with screen_lane.py's RF constant).
position_sizing: Equal-weight open positions, min(1/n_open, 0.10) per position, <=20 concurrent, remainder in BIL. For the short leg, negative weights are applied directly to the same P&L formula (w_i * r_i); no separate margin/collateral model beyond the borrow fee -- a simplification consistent with the frozen engine's own cash-remainder convention (1 - sum(weights) to BIL, which exceeds 100% notional in BIL when net short, approximating full cash collateralization of short proceeds).
plausibility_sources: reports/harness/source_cards/h20260929_20_news_nonews_drop_reversal.jsonl (referenced in external-brief.json: IBKR short-sale-cost schedule, QuantRocket borrow-fee context, a liquidity/spread explainer) -- used only to confirm the brief's preregistered cost numbers are directionally plausible, not to tune them.
not_modeled: Market impact beyond the fixed spread-bps assumption (no size-dependent impact model).
Locate/hard-to-borrow fee spikes beyond the flat 1%/year (the top-1000-ADV eligibility restriction is the only easy-to-borrow control).
Financing/margin interest on the long leg beyond the BIL cash-sleeve return.
